brief:
A Gaza Civil Defence worker recovered the bodies of 21 of his relatives from beneath rubble, Al Jazeera English reported. The recovery operation took place as rescue teams continued efforts to locate victims trapped under destroyed structures across the territory.

The discovery underscores the toll the conflict has taken on Palestinian families in Gaza, where widespread destruction has left many searching through debris for missing relatives. Rescue workers and civil defence personnel have faced mounting challenges as they work to recover bodies from collapsed buildings throughout the enclave.
dek: A Gaza Civil Defence worker helped recover the bodies of 21 of his relatives from beneath the rubble.
title: Gaza Civil Defence worker recovers 21 relatives from rubble
